newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Materials to expand in aluminium vehicles.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Materials to expand in aluminium vehicles.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Co said on Monday it planned to expand its aluminium vehicle sales and research and development operations by combining them with those of Mitsubishi Aluminum Co Ltd, one of its subsidiaries.

Confirming a report in the industrial daily Nikkei Sangyo Shimbun, a spokesman at Mitsubishi Materials said the two companies would jointly develop trucks with aluminium bodies, which would be able to handle heavier loads under Japan's planned stiffer weight rules for trucks.

The two companies have agreed to combine their aluminium vehicle-related sales and research and development divisions in the near future to strengthen their activities in the sector, the spokesman said.
Mitsubishi Materials holds a 67 percent stake in Mitsubishi Aluminum.
